What your elements do to you at work
Where you are right now, honestly
How you burn out, and how you come back from it
Feedback: taking it, giving it, surviving it
The job that actually fits you
What your best week at work looks like

plan2.title: How you work (your coworkers have noticed)

intake.question: Where are you with work right now?
What drains you most at work?

options.label: Boredom, the same thing every day

student.speaker: bom
student.text: Still studying. Perfect time to learn how you work, before a boss decides it for you.

early.speaker: yeon
early.text: Early in your career. So you're still saying "happy to help!" in emails you'd like to set on fire.

mid.speaker: yeon
mid.text: A few years in. Long enough to know the job. Not long enough to stop rewriting your Slack messages three times.

lead.speaker: bom
lead.text: Leading people. So now it's not just how you work. It's how a whole team feels on Monday morning.

between.speaker: bom
between.text: Between jobs. Honestly a great moment for this. You get to pick the next one on purpose.

unsaid.speaker: yeon
unsaid.text: You skipped where you are. Fine. Your birthday tells me how you work. Your face on Sunday night tells me the rest.

meetings.speaker: yeon
meetings.text: Endless meetings drain you. "This could have been an email" lives in your head rent-free.

unclear.speaker: yeon
unclear.text: Unclear goals drain you. You can do anything. You just need someone to say what "anything" is.

people.speaker: bom
people.text: Difficult people drain you. That's not you being sensitive. That's you paying a tax nobody else sees.

boredom.speaker: yeon
boredom.text: Boredom drains you. Same task, same day, same lunch. Your brain is filing a complaint.

unsaid.speaker: bom
unsaid.text: No answer on the draining part. We'll find it anyway. It's usually the thing you complain about on Thursdays.

strong.text:
Yeon: Strong chart. You work at one speed: full. Then you're surprised nobody else is at full.

Bom: You get things done that others give up on.

Yeon: You also send follow-ups to your follow-ups.

This week, before you jump in, ask one question: "What does done look like for you?" Saves you redoing someone else's version of done.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: You don't work hard. You work loud. Everyone can hear the keyboard.

weak.text:
Bom: Your chart runs soft. You work best with the right people around you, and you notice every mood in the office.

Yeon: Which is lovely, and also why one passive-aggressive email ruins your afternoon.

Bom: Your sensitivity is data. Not a weakness.

Protect one quiet hour a day. Notifications off. That's where your best work actually happens.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: One quiet hour a day. That's where you shine.

wood.heading: Your emails, honestly
wood.text:
Yeon: Subject line with a verb. Clear ask. A next step and a date. Then the "one more thing" paragraph that adds three projects.

Bom: One email, one direction. Send the extras later.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Your "one more thing" paragraph is a whole second email.

fire.heading: Your emails, honestly
fire.text:
Yeon: Exclamation marks. So many exclamation marks. "Thanks so much!!" "Love this!!"

Bom: Your warmth comes through. Just keep one sentence that says what you need.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Warm emails are great. Put the ask in the first line.

earth.heading: Your emails, honestly
earth.text:
Bom: Thorough, clear, every detail covered. People trust your emails.

Yeon: People also scroll for a while. Bullet points exist. Use them.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Three bullet points beat three paragraphs. Every time.

metal.heading: Your emails, honestly
metal.text:
Yeon: Short. Precise. Occasionally terrifying. "Per my last email" is your love language.

Bom: Add one warm line at the start. It doesn't weaken the point. It gets it read.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: "Per my last email" is technically a threat.

water.heading: Your emails, honestly
water.text:
Bom: Full of ideas. Interesting. Connected thoughts.

Yeon: Also no clear ask. People read it twice and still don't know what you want from them.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: End every email with one clear question.

wood.heading: What you need at work: room to grow
wood.text:
Bom: You need to feel you're getting somewhere. A new skill, a bigger project, a next step.

Yeon: Stagnation makes you update your CV in the toilets.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Tell your manager where you want to grow. Out loud.

fire.heading: What you need at work: to be seen
fire.text:
Yeon: You need your work noticed. Not credited in a footnote. Noticed.

Bom: Recognition is fuel for you. Ask for feedback, not just tasks.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Your work deserves a spotlight. Ask for the meeting slot.

earth.heading: What you need at work: stability
earth.text:
Bom: You need clear expectations and a steady rhythm. Then you're the most reliable person in the building.

Yeon: Constant reorgs make you quietly furious. And quietly job-hunting.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Ask what's expected. You'll exceed it every time.

metal.heading: What you need at work: standards
metal.text:
Yeon: You need things done properly. Clear rules, fair process, nobody cutting corners.

Bom: Sloppy work around you feels personal. It isn't. But your standards are a gift.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: You can spot a broken process from orbit.

water.heading: What you need at work: freedom to think
water.text:
Bom: You need space to think in your own way. Flexible time, big problems, freedom to connect the dots.

Yeon: Micromanagement makes you go silent. Then you go to a competitor.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Give you the problem, not the steps.

base.how-you-work:
You work like a pine grows: straight up, toward something you can see from far away.

Bom: You need direction before you give your best.

Yeon: And when there isn't one, you invent one. Then get annoyed nobody else is following it.

Bom: Your clarity is a gift. Share the map before you start running.

base_panels.speaker: bom
base_panels.text: The tall pine at work. Straight up, toward a goal.

base_panels.speaker: yeon
base_panels.text: Your edits have edits. And arrows. And a better plan.

base_panels.speaker: bom
base_panels.text: Once the direction's set, you're relentless. People follow you without being asked.

spring.intro: Spring birthday. That's tree season, so you got a double shot of yourself: taller, louder, surer. In saju terms, Wood ran the month you were born in. In real life, you've never once waited to be picked.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Double Wood. So the stubbornness is seasonal AND personal. Great.

summer.intro: You're a tree born in the heat. All that growing goes straight into showing: big plans, big talk, big gestures. Summer burns through a pine fast, so you look unstoppable right up until you suddenly need three days in bed.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: You give off so much light. Just save a little for yourself.

earth.intro: Born in the between-season weeks, when soil runs the show. For a tree, that means work: you're always building, fixing, providing. Very useful. Very tired. Somebody should ask what you want for once.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Rest is not a prize you win. It's allowed.

autumn.intro: Autumn is axe season, and you're the tree. Life started trimming you early: rules, pressure, people with opinions. It made you sharper and more disciplined than other pines. It also made you allergic to being told what to do.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Pruned young. Explains the posture. And the attitude.

winter.intro: A winter pine. The cold kept you quiet on the outside while the roots drank everything. You think longer than you let on, and when you finally move, it's because you already decided weeks ago.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: You look calm. Underneath, you've been planning since November.

open.title: You rewrote the brief before you'd finished reading it.
open.text:
Give you a vague task and you'll spend the first week turning it into a plan with a spine. Give you a clear goal and you'll hit it early.

Bom: You're a natural driver.

Yeon: You're a natural driver. You also drive other people's projects. Uninvited.
open.end: Yeon: How you work is obvious to everyone. What it's quietly costing you isn't. Next page.

cliff.text: Yeon: How you lead, Pine: people follow you because | you look certain. Half the time you're not. You just refuse to show it.

sample.text: Job vibe: you need a ladder you can see. Flat companies with "no titles" will make you lose your mind.

base.how-you-work:
You work like a vine: you find the structure that's there and grow along it, fast.

Bom: You adapt to any team, any boss, any change.

Yeon: You also say yes to everything because saying no feels rude. Your calendar is a crime scene.

Bom: Your flexibility is real. Use it on purpose, not by default.

base_panels.speaker: bom
base_panels.text: The climbing flower at work. Flexible, social, everyone's favourite colleague.

base_panels.speaker: yeon
base_panels.text: You're on first-name terms with every department. Including the one nobody visits.

base_panels.speaker: bom
base_panels.text: You grow through people. Your network is your superpower.

spring.intro: Spring birthday for the vine. Everything around you was growing, so you learned to grow toward whatever held still long enough. Charming. Flexible. Absolutely capable of getting your way while people believe they chose it.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Double Wood vine. You don't push. You wrap. Same result.

summer.intro: A flower in full sun. You bloom in public: the outfit, the story, the laugh across the room. The cost is that you wilt on the inside when nobody's watering you, and you'd rather die than ask.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: You're so easy to love. You just don't always let anyone try.

earth.intro: Born in the weeks between seasons, when the soil takes over. For a vine, that means you grow by managing things: schedules, people, plans. You're the reason the group trip happened. Nobody thanked you properly.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Unpaid project manager of every friendship. Since birth.

autumn.intro: Autumn is cutting season, and you're the soft stem. You grew up reading rooms for danger, learning who's sharp and how to bend before they swing. That's why you're so good with people. It's also why you apologise to furniture.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: You flinch at "can we talk" like it's a fire alarm.

winter.intro: A winter flower. Cold outside, so you grew inward: rich head, private feelings, a whole inner world nobody gets the password to. When you trust someone, it's total. Getting there takes a season.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Your inside is so much warmer than you let people see.

open.title: You know which manager is about to quit before HR does.
open.text:
You're the person who knows everyone. Every team, every department, every rumour. Doors open for you because people like you.

Bom: You're a natural connector.

Yeon: You're a natural connector and an unofficial HR department.
open.end: Yeon: How you work is through people. Where that goes wrong is the next page.

cliff.text: Yeon: How you lead, Flower: by making everyone feel | heard. Lovely. Then nobody makes a decision because you were waiting for consensus.

sample.text: Job vibe: collaborative, people-heavy, a manager who notices. Never a job where you eat lunch alone at your desk.

base.how-you-work:
You work like sunshine: big, warm, everywhere at once. You start strong and inspire everyone around you.

Bom: Your enthusiasm is a real asset.

Yeon: Your follow-through is a real question mark. Who's finishing the project you launched in March?

Bom: Pair your fire with someone who loves finishing. You'll be unstoppable.

base_panels.speaker: bom
base_panels.text: The sun at work. You light up every meeting.

base_panels.speaker: yeon
base_panels.text: Your status updates have a soundtrack.

base_panels.speaker: bom
base_panels.text: Your energy is contagious. Teams work harder when you're there.

spring.intro: The sun, born in spring. Everything was feeding you: new leaves, longer days, people who wanted your attention. So you grew up assuming warmth is normal. When someone's cold to you, it genuinely confuses you.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Rooms get brighter when you arrive. That is not nothing.

summer.intro: The sun at noon in July. Double fire. You don't enter rooms, you arrive. Generous, loud, impossible to ignore, and secretly a little hurt every time someone doesn't notice you lit the place up.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Main character, sequel, director's cut. All you.

earth.intro: Born in the between-season weeks, when Earth runs things. For the sun, that means everything you give turns into something solid: a friend's confidence, a plan that worked, a party you made happen. You're a great investment. Ask what you're getting back.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: You fund everyone's glow-up and forget to invoice.

autumn.intro: An autumn sun. Lower in the sky, aimed at things: harvest, goals, results. You're warm, but you're also counting. You notice exactly who showed up for you and who just liked the post.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Warm and keeping score. Your sunshine comes with receipts.

winter.intro: A winter sun. Short days, cold air, people who needed you more than they could give back. It made you tough and a little performative: the brightest one in the room, even on the days you're running on fumes.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: You shine hardest when you're the most tired. I see it.

open.title: You turned a five-minute update into a keynote. With slides.
open.text:
You bring the energy. Kick-offs, pitches, Friday drinks. When you're on, the whole team is on.

Bom: You make work feel exciting.

Yeon: You make work feel exciting and then lose interest in it around week four.
open.end: Yeon: How you work is bright. Where the light flickers is on the next page.

cliff.text: Yeon: How you lead, Sun: everyone loves you on day | one. By month three they'd like a plan to go with the pep talk.

sample.text: Job vibe: visible, fast, a stage of some kind. Put you in a back office and you'll wilt by Wednesday.

base.how-you-work:
You work like a candle burns: steady, focused, intense. One project at a time, all the way in.

Bom: Your quality is unmatched when you care.

Yeon: And when you don't care, it shows. Instantly. On your face. In the meeting.

Bom: Choose work you care about. It's not a luxury for you. It's how you function.

base_panels.speaker: bom
base_panels.text: The candle at work. Focused, detailed, deeply committed.

base_panels.speaker: yeon
base_panels.text: You also remember the exact meeting where someone took credit for your idea. March. Tuesday. 2pm.

base_panels.speaker: bom
base_panels.text: You give your work real heart. People can feel the care in it.

spring.intro: A candle lit in spring. Fed from every side, so your warmth is steady and close: one person, one conversation, the whole night. You'd take a deep two-hour talk over a party of fifty every single time.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: When you pay attention to someone, they feel chosen.

summer.intro: A candle in midsummer. Double fire, so the flame runs hot: intense focus, intense loyalty, intense feelings you insist are "fine". You don't do half anything. That includes holding a grudge.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: You remember a tone of voice from 2019. Word for word.

earth.intro: Born in the soil weeks between seasons. Your candle burns into the ground: caring, fixing, holding people together. You make every space feel like home. You also over-give until the wax runs out.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: You hosted everyone's crisis. Who's hosting yours?

autumn.intro: A candle in autumn, burning toward a goal. You're quietly ambitious, a little perfectionist, and you light up most when you're useful. The danger is that you start to believe useful is the only way to be loved.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: You don't have to earn the warmth you give everyone else.

winter.intro: A candle in winter. Cold all around, so your small flame matters more. You grew up being the warm one in a chilly place, which made you protective, careful, and very good at sensing a mood change from the next room.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: You can hear a sigh through a closed door. Through two.

open.title: You remember the exact meeting someone stole your idea. Tuesday. 2pm.
open.text:
You're the one who works late on the thing that matters. Quietly. Thoroughly. You notice the detail everyone else missed.

Bom: Your work has soul.

Yeon: Your work has soul and a very long memory for who didn't say thank you.
open.end: Yeon: How you work is devoted. Why that's risky is next page.

cliff.text: Yeon: How you lead, Candle: one-to-one, you're the best | manager anyone's had. In big rooms you go quiet, and people assume you don't care.

sample.text: Job vibe: meaningful, focused, a small team where your effort is seen. Open-plan chaos will drain your wax.

base.how-you-work:
You work like a mountain stands: steady, patient, impossible to knock over.

Bom: People rely on you completely.

Yeon: People also pile things on you because you never complain. Mountains don't complain. They just get taller and more tired.

Bom: Your reliability is rare. Make sure it's rewarded, not just used.

base_panels.speaker: bom
base_panels.text: The mountain at work. Steady, reliable, everyone's backup.

base_panels.speaker: yeon
base_panels.text: You've used the same notebook system since 2016. It works. Leave it alone.

base_panels.speaker: bom
base_panels.text: You're the person the team trusts in a crisis. Calm when everyone else panics.

spring.intro: A mountain in spring, with trees pushing through it from every side. Life tested you early. That's why you're so steady now, and also why "relax" sounds to you like a trick.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: You became the calm one because someone had to.

summer.intro: A summer mountain, warmed all the way through. Solid, generous, the one everyone leans on. You give off safety without trying. People tell you things they've never told anyone, and you never repeat them.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: People feel safe with you within five minutes. Rare.

earth.intro: A mountain born in Earth's own weeks. Triple solid. You don't move unless you want to, and you almost never want to. Your loyalty is legendary. So is the time it takes you to change your mind.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Persuading you is a geological process.

autumn.intro: An autumn mountain, showing its stone. You turn your weight into output: work done, things built, problems quietly solved. You don't talk about feelings much. You show them by fixing the shelf.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Love language: unasked-for repairs. Every time.

winter.intro: A mountain in winter, holding back the river. You manage things: money, plans, other people's chaos. Very good at it. The cost is that you rarely let anything thaw, including you.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: You're not cold. You're frozen on purpose. Different.

open.title: You hear the word "pivot" and your soul leaves your body.
open.text:
You're the steady one. Deadlines met, promises kept, zero drama. When the project's on fire, people look for you.

Bom: You're the team's foundation.

Yeon: You're the team's foundation and the last person to adopt any new software. Ever.
open.end: Yeon: How you work is solid. What solid costs you is next page.

cliff.text: Yeon: How you lead, Mountain: people feel safe under | you. They also wait a long time for you to change anything. Some of them stop waiting.

sample.text: Job vibe: stable, clear, built to last. A start-up that pivots weekly will give you a twitch.

base.how-you-work:
You work like good soil: everything around you grows. Projects, people, the team mood.

Bom: You're the person everyone's glad is on the team.

Yeon: You're also the person who says "I can take that" until you can't take anything.

Bom: Your support is gold. Put some of it into your own career too.

base_panels.speaker: bom
base_panels.text: The garden field at work. Supportive, practical, the one who makes things run.

base_panels.speaker: yeon
base_panels.text: You also organised the leaving card, the cake and the group gift. For someone you've met twice.

base_panels.speaker: bom
base_panels.text: You make everyone else's work easier. Teams run smoother with you.

spring.intro: A garden in spring, with everything sprouting from you at once. You grew up being needed: the friend who listens, the kid who helped. Lovely trait. Exhausting default.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: You nourish everybody. Your turn next.

summer.intro: Garden soil in summer, warm and rich. You're nurturing on instinct and practical about it: snacks in the bag, charger for everyone, a plan B nobody asked for. Everyone feels a bit safer near you.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: You packed plasters for a picnic. Twice.

earth.intro: Soil born in soil weeks. Double Earth. You're the steady one, the reliable one, the one who remembers birthdays. You can also absorb other people's moods like a sponge and call it "being supportive".

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Their mood, your weekend. Every time.

autumn.intro: A harvest-season garden. Everything you grow, you hand out. Ideas, help, advice, food. The harvest is real, but so is the empty field afterwards, and you never schedule time to grow back.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Giving is your gift. Refilling is your homework.

winter.intro: A winter garden. Frozen on top, busy underneath. You worry productively: lists, backups, a mental spreadsheet of who needs what. You keep it together for everyone, and you'd never admit you're scared too.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: You overthink in organised folders. Colour-coded.

open.title: You organised the leaving cake for someone you'd met twice.
open.text:
You're the one who notices the new hire looks lost. The one who fixes the shared calendar. The one who actually reads the onboarding doc.

Bom: You make the whole team work.

Yeon: You make the whole team work and somehow your own tasks happen at 9pm.
open.end: Yeon: How you work is generous. Where it backfires is next page.

cliff.text: Yeon: How you lead, Field: you protect your team from | everything, including the feedback they need. Kind. Not always helpful.

sample.text: Job vibe: a team that values care, with a manager who notices it. Not a place where "helpful" is your whole review.

base.how-you-work:
You work like a blade: you find the problem and cut straight to it.

Bom: You get results others are too scared to chase.

Yeon: You also make people cry in reviews. Not on purpose. You just said the true thing with no cushion.

Bom: Your directness is valuable. Add one warm sentence before the sharp one.

base_panels.speaker: bom
base_panels.text: The sword at work. Direct, decisive, gets it done.

base_panels.speaker: yeon
base_panels.text: Your manager schedules you last in meetings. For everyone's safety.

base_panels.speaker: bom
base_panels.text: You cut through the noise. People trust your honesty.

spring.intro: A blade born in spring, surrounded by things to cut. You see what needs doing and you do it, preferably before anyone has finished explaining. Efficient. Also sometimes the reason the meeting went badly.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: You solved their problem. They wanted a hug. Classic.

summer.intro: A sword forged in summer. Heat everywhere, so you were shaped by pressure: deadlines, expectations, people who pushed. It made you strong and principled. It also made you assume love is a test you can fail.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: You don't have to pass anything. You're already loved.

earth.intro: A sword still in the stone. Born in the soil weeks, so you were held, fed and protected before you were ever swung. That gives you patience most Swords lack, and a stubborn streak made of actual rock.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Patient, until you're not. Then it's a sword.

autumn.intro: A sword born in autumn, metal's own season. Double steel. Loyal to the bone, blunt as a brick, and fair in a way that scares people. You'd fight anyone for a friend, and tell that friend exactly where they went wrong on the way home.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: You'd take a bullet for a friend. Then critique their aim.

winter.intro: A blade in winter. Cold, clear, and sharpened by thinking. You say less than other Swords, but when you speak it lands like a verdict. People quote you back to yourself years later.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Your words stay with people. Choose the kind ones too.

open.title: You told the director it was a bad idea. In the meeting. You were right.
open.text:
You see what's broken and you say so. Immediately. Directly. Your manager has learned to schedule you last in meetings.

Bom: You're the honest one.

Yeon: You're the honest one, and HR knows your name. Not in a bad way. Mostly.
open.end: Yeon: How you work is sharp. How it lands on other people is next page.

cliff.text: Yeon: How you lead, Sword: your team would follow you | into battle. They'd also love one meeting where you don't fix something they didn't ask you to fix.

sample.text: Job vibe: real problems, real stakes, no politics. Office drama will make you want to quit by lunch.

base.how-you-work:
You work like a jeweller: precise, patient, obsessed with the finish.

Bom: Your work makes the whole team look good.

Yeon: Your work also takes three times longer because "good enough" physically hurts you.

Bom: Your standards are a gift. Pick which tasks deserve the full polish.

base_panels.speaker: bom
base_panels.text: The jewel at work. Precise, polished, your work is beautiful.

base_panels.speaker: yeon
base_panels.text: You've proofread an email so many times the words stopped looking real.

base_panels.speaker: bom
base_panels.text: Your quality bar is high. People know your work by the finish.

spring.intro: A jewel born in spring. Everything was growing and you noticed all of it: what's pretty, what's off, what's three millimetres crooked. You have taste. You also have opinions about other people's taste.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: You judged the font on their birthday card. Silently.

summer.intro: A jewel in summer heat. Pressure shaped you: to look good, do well, never be the embarrassing one. You're polished and impressive. One careless comment can still ruin your whole week.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: You're allowed to be unfinished. It's charming, honestly.

earth.intro: A jewel still in the earth. Born in the soil weeks, so you were protected, maybe a little over-protected. You need to feel safe before you sparkle, and that's not a flaw. It's quality control.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: You need three green flags before one selfie.

autumn.intro: A jewel born in metal's own season. Double shine. High standards, sharp eye, zero patience for sloppy. You're the friend people dress up for. You're also the friend people are slightly scared to disappoint.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: You're a five-star review. With a long comment section.

winter.intro: A jewel in winter water, washed clear. Your mind is quick and your words are precise. You can say one sentence that fixes everything, or one that ends everything. Most of the time you know which.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: You see people so clearly. Use it to be kind.

open.title: You rewrote one sentence in the deck eleven times.
open.text:
Your work is clean, precise, considered. Every slide aligned. Every email proofread twice. People hand you the thing that has to be perfect.

Bom: You have real taste.

Yeon: You have real taste and a crippling fear of the typo that slipped through in 2022.
open.end: Yeon: How you work is polished. What the polishing costs is next page.

cliff.text: Yeon: How you lead, Jewel: your team does great work | because they're slightly scared of disappointing you. You think they just love quality.

sample.text: Job vibe: craft, quality, a place that notices the details. A "move fast and break things" office will break you.

base.how-you-work:
You work like the ocean: deep, wide, always moving. You thrive on big problems and freedom.

Bom: Your vision is genuinely rare.

Yeon: Your admin is genuinely tragic. There's a receipt from 2023 you still haven't expensed.

Bom: Pair yourself with a finisher. Your ideas deserve to exist.

base_panels.speaker: bom
base_panels.text: The ocean at work. Big ideas, big picture, endless curiosity.

base_panels.speaker: yeon
base_panels.text: Your brainstorm notes need their own brainstorm.

base_panels.speaker: bom
base_panels.text: You connect dots nobody else can see. Strategy is your playground.

spring.intro: The ocean in spring, pouring itself into everything that grows. You're full of ideas and you give them away: plans, pep talks, 3am theories. People feel bigger around you. You sometimes feel emptier after.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: You make people feel possible. Keep a little for you.

summer.intro: The ocean in summer, chasing everything. Big appetite for life: trips, people, projects, the next thing. You're magnetic and hard to pin down. Being pinned down is honestly your nightmare.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: You said "let's see where it goes". You meant "don't make me commit".

earth.intro: An ocean held by cliffs. Born in the soil weeks, so you grew up with banks and rules around you. It gave you focus. It also left you with a quiet itch to flood something just to prove you can.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: You follow every rule. Until one random Tuesday.

autumn.intro: The ocean in autumn, fed by every stream. Deep, informed, a little too clever. You absorb everything and you can talk your way out of anything. That includes your own feelings.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: You intellectualise heartbreak. With footnotes.

winter.intro: The ocean in winter. Double water. Deep, cold on top, enormous underneath. You need a lot of freedom and you think in huge loops. People call you mysterious. You just haven't decided yet.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Your depth scares shallow people. That's their problem.

open.title: Fourteen tabs open. Three are work. One is flights.
open.text:
You're the ideas person. The "what if we" in every brainstorm. You see where the industry's going before the industry does.

Bom: You think bigger than anyone in the room.

Yeon: You think bigger than anyone in the room and finish less than anyone in the room.
open.end: Yeon: How you work is wide. Where it leaks is next page.

cliff.text: Yeon: How you lead, Ocean: you inspire people with the | vision, then vanish into the next big idea before anyone knows what Monday looks like.

sample.text: Job vibe: autonomy, big questions, flexible hours. A rigid nine-to-five with a time tracker will make you feral.

base.how-you-work:
You work like rain: quiet, steady, soaking into everything. Nobody sees the effort. Everyone sees the results.

Bom: Your intuition about people and projects is scary accurate.

Yeon: And your visibility is zero. Your manager thinks the project went well "somehow".

Bom: Say one thing you did out loud each week. That's not bragging. That's information.

base_panels.speaker: bom
base_panels.text: The rain at work. Quiet, intuitive, sees what others miss.

base_panels.speaker: yeon
base_panels.text: You also knew the reorg was coming three weeks before the announcement. You told nobody.

base_panels.speaker: bom
base_panels.text: You read the room better than anyone. People don't realise how much you're holding.

spring.intro: Spring rain. You feed everything around you without anyone noticing it was you. You sense moods, fix vibes, water other people's plants. Quietly essential. Quietly forgotten. Not anymore.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Everything grows a little when you're around.

summer.intro: Rain in summer, gone the moment it lands. You chase what you want in quiet, clever ways, and you vanish when a room gets too loud. People find you fascinating. They also never quite know where you went.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: You left the party without saying bye. Again. Iconic.

earth.intro: Rain falling on hard ground. Born in the soil weeks, so you met walls early: rules, expectations, people who didn't get you. You learned to soak in slowly instead of crashing through. Patient. Persistent. Underrated.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: You don't fight walls. You just wear them down. Over years.

autumn.intro: Autumn rain, fed by cool clean air. Intuitive to the point of spooky. You know who's lying, who's sad, and who's about to text before your phone even lights up.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Your gut is right more often than your decisions are.

winter.intro: Winter rain. Double water. Still, deep, mostly internal. You feel everything at full volume and show about four percent of it. Your notes app has more emotional range than most novels.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Your quiet isn't empty. It's full.

open.title: You knew about the reorg three weeks early. You told nobody.
open.text:
You're the quiet one in meetings. Then you say one sentence and the whole plan changes. People underestimate you right up until they don't.

Bom: You see so clearly.

Yeon: You see so clearly and speak so rarely that people forget to ask you.
open.end: Yeon: How you work is under the surface. Getting it seen is next page.

cliff.text: Yeon: How you lead, Rain: so gently people don't | realise they're being led. Brilliant. Until they credit someone louder.

sample.text: Job vibe: thoughtful, calm, written communication over shouting. An open-plan sales floor will evaporate you.
